summary: Httpapi plugins tell Ansible how to work with a device's HTTP API. Each covers an API dialect, some platform-specific like Arista eAPI or Cisco NXAPI and others generic like RESTCONF. They are loaded automatically from ansible_network_os.
questions: How does Ansible talk to a switch over its REST API?
Is there a generic httpapi plugin for RESTCONF devices?

answer_card.title: What httpapi plugins are
answer_card.answer_md: Httpapi plugins define how Ansible talks to a device's HTTP-based API. Each plugin is one API dialect. Some are platform-specific (Arista eAPI, Cisco NXAPI) and some are generic (RESTCONF). Ansible picks the plugin from `ansible_network_os`.
